import time

_SHRINK = 2.0e-7

_CENTERS = np.array([

    [0.9059919955147084, 0.9059919955147074],
    [0.10180899211692869, 0.10180899211692893],
], dtype=np.float64)

    0.036882666707539466,

], dtype=np.float64)


def _initial_centers():
    pts = []
    for y in np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 5):
        for x in np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 5):
            pts.append((x, y))
    pts.append((0.2, 0.2))
    return np.array(pts, dtype=np.float64)


def _valid(centers, radii, tol=1e-6):
    centers = np.asarray(centers, dtype=np.float64)
    radii = np.asarray(radii, dtype=np.float64)
    if centers.shape != (N, 2) or radii.shape != (N,):
        return False
    if not (np.all(np.isfinite(centers)) and np.all(np.isfinite(radii))):
        return False
    if np.any(radii < -tol):
        return False
    x = centers[:, 0]
    y = centers[:, 1]
    if np.any(x - radii < -tol) or np.any(1.0 - x - radii < -tol):
        return False
    if np.any(y - radii < -tol) or np.any(1.0 - y - radii < -tol):
        return False
    for i in range(N - 1):
        d = centers[i + 1:] - centers[i]
        dist = np.sqrt(np.sum(d * d, axis=1))
        if np.any(dist + tol < radii[i] + radii[i + 1:]):
            return False
    return True


def _lp_radii(centers):
    centers = np.asarray(centers, dtype=np.float64)
    n = len(centers)
    b = np.minimum.reduce((centers[:, 0], centers[:, 1],
                           1.0 - centers[:, 0], 1.0 - centers[:, 1]))
    b = np.maximum(b - 2.0e-7, 0.0)
    try:
        from scipy.optimize import linprog
        rows = []
        rhs = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                a = np.zeros(n)
                a[i] = 1.0
                a[j] = 1.0
                rows.append(a)
                rhs.append(max(0.0, float(np.linalg.norm(centers[i] - centers[j])) - 2.0e-7))
        res = linprog(-np.ones(n), A_ub=np.array(rows), b_ub=np.array(rhs),
                      bounds=[(0.0, float(v)) for v in b], method="highs")
        if res.success and np.all(np.isfinite(res.x)):
            r = np.maximum(res.x, 0.0)
            if _valid(centers, r, 1e-6):
                return r
    except Exception:
        pass
    return np.minimum(b, 0.099999)


def construct_packing():
    start = time.time()
    deadline = start + 24.0

    centers = _CENTERS.copy()
    radii = np.maximum(_BASE_RADII - _SHRINK, 0.0)

    if time.time() < deadline - 2.0 and not _valid(centers, radii, 1e-6):
        lr = _lp_radii(centers)
        if _valid(centers, lr, 1e-6):
            radii = lr

    if not _valid(centers, radii, 1e-6):
        centers = _initial_centers()
        radii = np.full(N, 0.099999, dtype=np.float64)
        radii[-1] = max(0.0, np.sqrt(0.02) - 0.099999 - 2e-7)

    return centers, radii, float(np.sum(radii))


def run_packing():
    centers, radii, sum_radii = construct_packing()
    return centers, radii, sum_radii


def visualize(centers, radii):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.patches import Circle
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.grid(True)
    for i, (center, radius) in enumerate(zip(centers, radii)):
        ax.add_patch(Circle(center, radius, alpha=0.5))
        ax.text(center[0], center[1], str(i), ha="center", va="center")
    plt.title(f"Circle Packing (n={len(centers)}, sum={sum(radii):.6f})")
    plt.show()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    c, r, s = run_packing()
    print(f"Sum of radii: {s}")
